THREADS_MOVED_MIN.meaning: at least 3 of the arc doc's 5 tracked threads have moved (a thread_move fired) at least once this life

ROLE_GOALS_ADVANCED_MIN.meaning: at least 2 present souls' role-goals have advanced at least one stage this life

proposed_predicates.meaning: count of arc-doc threads whose thread_move ladder has advanced at least once this life is >= N
proposed_predicates.schema_status: NEW — not in the screen-spec predicate vocabulary; adding it is a schema change at the gate

proposed_predicates.meaning: count of present souls whose role-goal has advanced at least one stage this life is >= N
proposed_predicates.schema_status: NEW — same schema change at the gate

rationale: The Arch is the calendar-read landmark: it should sharpen from scenery into a hard-key exactly when the town's stories have visibly moved, so the promotion reads as the world aging rather than as a reward. Both inputs are ladders the pipeline already tracks — thread_move on the arc doc's five threads, and role-goal stages, the same engine that feeds the festival tier. Requiring 3 of 5 threads moved plus 2 role-goals advanced demands breadth (the player has been in the town's life, not maxing one lane) while staying reachable inside a 5-day run. Bond is excluded by the ruling and by check 2, which keeps the promotion about the town's motion, never the player's closeness to any one soul.
notes: Schema gap: the current predicate vocabulary cannot express either ruled input — the vocabulary table closes with 'anything not in this table is not a predicate.' This proposal therefore doubles as a schema-change request at the gate (the same rule as state_actions).

Thread identifiers: the arc doc's thread table names threads in prose without IDs; the choice-node acceptance case references 'giver-receive' as a thread_id. The formula counts threads by whatever canonical thread_id list the arc doc adopts — not proposed here.
'Advanced one stage' for role-goals assumes role-goal progress is staged; if it is continuous, the threshold shape needs Roc's read.
